blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery often places class boundaries a few pixels away from where they truly lie, and this position error is concentrated in the thin band measured by Boundary IoU (BIoU). We treat boundary refinement as the iterated application of a small learned local rule: the Boundary Refinement Neural Cellular Automaton (BRNCA), that starts from the class probabilities of a frozen, pre-trained segmenter and corrects them cell by cell. We generalise the binary rNCA to the multiclass case by keeping the visible channels on the probability simplex through an Aitchison (log-space) update and by adding free hidden channels. The best configuration improves the mean BIoU over the base segmenter by 2.36 points (from 46.63 to 48.99). The gain is concentrated on the irregular woodland class (+8.5 points BIoU); this suggests that position error is correlated with the fractal dimension of the class boundaries.
blocks.zh: 对遥感图像进行语义分解时,往往会将类分界线放出一些像素,使其远离它们真正所躺的地方,而这种位置误差集中在由边界IoU(BIoU)所测量的薄带上. 我们把边界的完善视为对一个小而有学问的局部规则的反复应用:边界完善神经细胞自通(BRNCA),它从被冷冻,预先训练的分管器的类概率开始,逐个细胞加以纠正. 我们通过一个Aitchison(log-space)更新,将二进制 rNCA 常规化到多类的大小写中,通过保留概率简单x上的可见道并添加自由隐藏道. 最佳配置将平均BIOU比基分器提高2.36分(从46.63分到48.99分). 增益集中于不规则的林地类(+8.5分 BIOU);这说明位置误差与类分界线分形维度相关.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Land use and land cover (LULC) maps underpin the monitoring of territorial change and
evidence-based environmental policy. In remote sensing, producing them is a multiclass semantic
segmentation problem: every pixel receives exactly one of several categories, so every region is
delimited by the boundaries it shares with its neighbours, and the quality of the map depends
directly on where those boundaries are placed. Modern segmenters, from convolutional
networks [ 7 , 15 ] to Vision
Transformers [ 4 ] and foundation-model encoders [ 11 , 14 ] , are good at deciding what a region is and less
reliable at deciding its boundary.

blocks.en:
We distinguish two kinds of error ( Figure 1 ). A semantic error assigns a whole
region to the wrong class. A position error occurs when the interiors of two neighbouring
regions are classified correctly but the decision boundary separating them is displaced with
respect to the true one. Global metrics such as IoU mix both effects and are dominated by
interiors. Boundary IoU (BIoU) [ 3 ] restricts the computation to a
narrow band around the annotated boundary and therefore isolates position error; its
complement, Interior IoU (IIoU), measures the remainder of each region. State-of-the-art
segmenters typically score a much lower BIoU than IoU [ 3 ] , demonstrating that boundary refinement remains an open challenge.

blocks.en:
Two further obstacles are specific to remote sensing. First, the contours of natural classes
(vegetation, rock, water) are highly irregular and can be characterised by fractal dimension [ 9 , 19 ] . Second, a segmenter sees the scene through a finite window
(the raster crop, the backbone patch, the convolution kernel or attention window) that is much
smaller than the continuous scene it represents. We quantify the first obstacle through the fractal
dimension of the class boundaries ( Section 4.1 ) and address the second with
local, iterated refinement.
blocks.zh:
另外两个障碍是遥感方面的具体障碍。 第一,自然阶级的轮廓
(植被,岩石,水)非常不规则,可以分形维度[9,19]为特征. 第二,一个片段员通过有限的窗口看到场景
(光栅作物、骨干补丁、内核或注意力窗口)
比它所代表的连续场景小。 我们通过分形来量化第一个障碍

地方性的,有节奏的改进。

blocks.en:
Cellular automata (CA) [ 17 , 21 ] apply one simple rule uniformly to the
immediate neighbourhood of every cell. Such a rule works at the native image resolution, and can be
directed to the boundary, leaving interior decisions that are already correct untouched. A
Neural Cellular Automaton (NCA) [ 10 ] parametrises the rule with a small
neural network and trains it by back-propagation through time (BPTT) [ 20 ] ; unrolling the automaton’s time steps, it can be seen as a recurrent residual convolutional network.
rNCA [ 16 ] showed that an NCA can repair binary segmentation masks. Here we generalise the idea to multiclass segmentation with the Boundary Refinement Neural Cellular Automaton (BRNCA) and ask a deliberately narrow question: what
is the smallest NCA that moves boundaries to the right place?

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Mordvintsev et al. [ 10 ] introduced NCAs to grow and regenerate a 64 × 64 64\times 64 RGBA image. Every cell holds a state vector that is updated, in parallel and with the
same rule, by two modules: perception , which aggregates the neighbours with a fixed bank of
depthwise kernels (identity and Sobel), and update , a shallow network that maps the
perception vector to a state increment. Later works prune the machinery of the original NCA: Variational NCA [ 13 ] dispenses with the alive mask, and NoiseNCA [ 12 ] additionally removes the
stochastic asynchronous update, injecting noise in the perception stage instead.
blocks.zh:
Modvintsev等 [10] 引入了NCAA来生长并再生出一个64×64\times 64 RGBA图像. 每个单元格都有一个状态向量,经过更新、平行和与
同一规则,通过两个模块: 感知 将邻居与固定的
深度内核(身份和Sobel),并更新,一个浅层网络,绘制
知觉向量到状态增量。 后来的工作为原始NCAA的机械: Variational NCAA [13] 免去活口罩,而NoiseNCA [12] 额外去除活口罩.
同步更新,在感知阶段注入噪音

blocks.en:
rNCA [ 16 ] is the closest work to our proposal. It applies an NCA to the output of a dense
segmenter to repair binary masks of medical images, conditioning the rule on the input image;
it targets topological errors (fragmented vessels, broken myocardium), measured with Dice, clDice
and Betti errors. We instead target boundary position in the multiclass setting of
land cover mapping.
blocks.zh:
rNCA[16]是最接近我们提案的工作. 它将NCA应用于稠密度的输出
用于修复医疗图像的二进制口罩,规范输入图像的规则;
它以地表误差(破碎的血管,破碎的心肌)为对象,用地虱和克氏剂测量
和贝蒂的错误。 相反,我们的目标是在多类设定中的边界位置:
土地覆盖物测绘.

blocks.en:
The dense CRF [ 6 ] is the classic multiclass refiner: a unary term from
the base prediction and a pairwise term that penalises label disagreement between pixels close in
space and appearance. CRF-as-RNN [ 23 ] parametrises the CRF as a differentiable
recurrent network, and ClassWise-CRF [ 24 ] adapts it to remote sensing.
Model-agnostic refiners post-process the output of any segmenter: SegFix [ 22 ] replaces the labels of boundary pixels with those of interior pixels, guided by predicted boundary
and direction maps, and SegRefiner [ 18 ] refines coarse masks through a discrete
diffusion process.

基数预测和一个双向词,用来惩罚像素之间接近的分歧
空间和外观。 CRF-as-RNN [23] 将CRF视为一种不同的
ClassWise-CRF[24]使其适应遥感。
SegFix [22] 将边界像素的标签替换为内部像素的标签,以预测的边界为导向
和方向图, 和Seg Refinner [18] 精细的口罩通过离散
传播过程。

blocks.en: 3.3 Design choices: a minimal BRNCA
blocks.zh: 3.3 设计选择:最低限度的BRNCA

blocks.en:
Earlier NCAs for growth and repair carry extra machinery: an alive mask, a sample pool and
stochastic asynchronous updates [ 10 , 16 ] . We drop all three components.
These are design decisions justified by our setting; they are not part of the core ablation of Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh:
早期用于生长和维修的NCAA携带了额外的机械:活口罩、样本池和
stochtic a s同步更新 [10, 16]. 我们放下所有三个部件。
这些是设计决定,以我们的设定为理由;它们不属于第4.3节的核心范围。

blocks.en:
In Growing NCA the alive mask separates cells that take part in growth from empty background, and rNCA
reuses its visible probability channel for that role. Variational NCA [ 13 ] and
NoiseNCA [ 12 ] dispense with it. In our setting the initial state is the dense
output of a segmenter, not a sparse seed, so every cell carries a meaningful class distribution from t = 0 t=0 and there is no growth front to gate. There is a second argument specific to boundary position.
When class boundaries are misaligned, the incorrectly included pixels typically belong to regions classified with high confidence, meaning the model is sure of the category but blind to its precise limits. A mask driven by the state, whether by confidence or by margin, would tend to freeze exactly the cells that
must change class for the boundary to move, and would tie the region where the boundary may move to the
region where the base model already placed it. Leaving every cell free lets f θ f_{\theta} decide, from
perception and conditioning, where to act.
blocks.zh:
在生长NCA中,活口罩将参与生长的细胞从空背景分离出,而rNCA
重用其该角色的可见概率通道 。 变式NCA[13]和
噪音NCA [12] 摆脱它。 在我们的设定中,初始状态是密集
输出出一个分块器,而不是一个稀有的种子,所以每个细胞都带有从t=0 t=0的有意义的类分布,并且没有生长前端到出门. 有两个具体的论点涉及边界位置。
当类边界错位时,被错误地包含的像素一般属于被高度信任地分类的区域,这意味着模型对类别是肯定的,但对它的精确限制是盲目的. 国家驱动的口罩,无论是通过信心还是边际,都倾向于完全冻结那些细胞。
边界必须改变类别才能移动,并将边界可能移动到
(b) 基准模型已放置该模型的区域。 离开每个细胞,让我们决定,从
感知和调节,在哪里行动。

blocks.en:
The pool maintains previously evolved state tensors to stabilise training across long trajectories and promote pattern persistence, feeding back a mixed batch comprising states sampled from the pool alongside fresh predictions generated directly by the base segmenter.
However, in our boundary refinement setting, every training iteration starts directly from the base segmenter’s output p 0 p_{0} and a zero hidden state, matching the inference procedure while eliminating additional RAM–VRAM transfer overhead.
Without the pool, the rule is never trained on states beyond the maximum training step ( T = 64 T=64 ); we measure the impact of this choice in Section 4.6 .
blocks.zh:
该水池维持了以前演化的状态分数器,以稳定跨越长轨的训练,并推广模式持久性,将一组从水池中抽取的状态与由基准分数器直接产生的新预测一起反馈。
然而,在我们边界的完善设置中,每一次训练迭接都直接从基段的输出p0 (p_{0) 和零隐藏状态开始,匹配推断程序,同时取消额外的RAM - VRAM 传输上层.
没有人才库,规则就从未在最大训练步骤(T = 64 T = 64)以外的州进行训练;我们在4.6节中衡量这一选择的影响.

blocks.en: Unlike Growing NCA, which updates cells asynchronously, governed by a stochastic update probability and gated by an alive mask, in BRNCA every cell updates synchronously at every time step ( p stoch = 1 p_{\text{stoch}}=1 ) without pixelwise dropout or spatial gating.
blocks.zh: 与增长NCA不同,NCA同步更新了细胞,它受有色更新概率的调节并被活口口罩入门,在BRNCA中,每个细胞在每一个步骤(p stoch = 1 p_{\text{stoch}}=1)上同步更新,而不会像素退位或空间吉他.

blocks.en: 3.4 Training and inference
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训和推断

blocks.en:
The automaton runs for T T steps and is trained by BPTT with the cross-entropy between the final visible
channels p T p_{T} and the ground truth, averaged over pixels (computed as the negative log-likelihood of p T p_{T} , which already lies on the simplex). During training, the number of automaton steps T T is set between 32 32 and 64 64 (so T = 64 T=64 is the maximum training step); at inference, T = 64 T=64 . The base segmenter stays frozen throughout.

自动马通为 T T 步跑, 由 BPTT 训练, 并在最后可见的相间交叉切入
频道 p T QQT} 和地面真理, 平均在像素之上( 被算作 p T 的负日志相似 ), 这已经存在于 simplex上 。 在训练期间,自发步骤T T被设定在32到64 64之间(因此T=64 T=64是最大训练步骤);推论,T=64 T=64. 基部分叉一直被冻结

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 LandCover.ai Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1 地道网.ai 数据集

blocks.en:
LandCover.ai [ 2 ] consists of aerial orthophotos of Poland (41 images, 25–50 cm/pixel; 8 images of 4200 × 4700 4200\times 4700 and 33 of 9000 × 9500 9000\times 9500 pixels) with five classes: background, building,
woodland, water and road. It is the benchmark on which the core ablation is performed in Section 4.3 . Figure 3 illustrates the pixelwise annotation.
blocks.zh:
LandCover.ai [2]由波兰的航空正反相片组成(41个图像,25-50厘米/像素;8个图像为4200×4700 4.200\times 4700和33个9000×9500 9.000\times 9500像素),分为5个类:背景,建筑,
林地、水和公路。 这是第4.3节中核心减缩的基准。 图3显示了像素化的注释。

blocks.en:
To quantify how intricate the annotated boundaries are, we estimate the fractal dimension D D of each class boundary
by box counting on the contour of the binary class-versus-rest mask (extracted with a morphological gradient),
fitting log ⁡ N ⁡ ( r ) = D ​ log ⁡ ( 1 / r ) + C \log N(r)=D\log(1/r)+C by least squares, where N ⁡ ( r ) N(r) is the number of boxes of side r r needed to cover
the contour. For the LandCover.ai dataset, the per-class values range from D = 1.13 D=1.13 (water) to D = 1.33 D=1.33 (background), so the classes differ
moderately, but enough to be ordered: water < < building < < road < < woodland < < background.

根据二进制类掩体的轮廓(取自形态梯度),

轮廓。 为地道道. ai 数据集,每类值从 D = 1.13 D = 1.13 (水)到 D = 1.33 D = 1.33 (背景),所以类别不同.
中度但足够订购:水 " 建筑 " 道路 " 林地 " 背景 " 。

blocks.en: Boundary complexity is computed on the annotated masks at their native resolution, serving as a key factor for appropriate boundary refinement. The high D D value for the background class occurs because it represents the complement of the other four classes; consequently, its contour consists of the interfaces with all of them, meaning D D does not reflect the property of a natural land-cover class.
blocks.zh: 边界的复杂性是按其原生分辨率附加说明的口罩计算的,这是适当完善边界的一个关键因素。 背景类的高D值会发生,因为它代表了其他四个类的互补;因此,它的轮廓由与所有它们的接口所组成,意思是D并不反映自然地覆盖类的财产.

blocks.en: 4.2 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 设置

blocks.en:
The base segmenter is a Dense Prediction Transformer [ 14 ] with a DINOv2 encoder [ 11 ] (DPT–DINOv2), kept frozen. It operates with a input size of 518 × 518 518\times 518 , whereas BRNCA processes four 259 × 259 259\times 259 sub-windows that are subsequently reconstructed for direct comparison. On LandCover.ai, the base segmenter achieves 83.69% mIoU and 46.63% BmIoU ( Table 1 ), establishing the floor that BRNCA must improve. We report per-class IoU, BIoU and IIoU along with their class averages (mIoU, BmIoU, mIIoU); gains Δ \Delta represent differences relative to the base segmenter, expressed in percentage points (pp). BIoU is computed on a band of width d = 5 d=5 pixels around the annotated contour. We use
AdamW [ 8 ] with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Reported numbers correspond to the epoch with the best BmIoU, with early stopping (patience of 10 epochs) and a maximum of 60 epochs. Experiments ran on single nodes of the SDumont supercomputer (LNCC), each with 6 CPU cores per task, 64 GB of RAM, and four 32 GB Tesla V100 GPUs.
blocks.zh:
基分器是一款有Dense Presidentary Transformer [14] 有DINov2编码器 [11] (DPT-DINOv2),保持被冻结. 它的操作输入大小为518×518 518\times 518,而BRNCA处理4个259×259\times 259分窗,后被重建为可直接比较的子窗. 在LandCover.ai上,基分机实现83.69%mIoU和46.63%BmIoU(表1),建立了BRNCA必须改进的地层. 我们报告每类IoU、BIOU和IIoU的同级平均值(mIOU、BmIOU、mIIoU);收益======================================================= BIoU是用宽度d = 5 d = 5 像素环绕有注释的轮廓来计算. 我们用
AdamW [8] 的学习率 10 - 4 10 - 4}。 被报道的数字对应以最佳 BmIoU 为主题的纪元,早期停止(patience of 10 epoces),最多60个纪元. 实验运行于斯杜蒙特超级计算机(LNCC)的单节点上,每个任务都有6个CPU核心,64GB的RAM,以及4个32GB的特斯拉V100GPU.

blocks.en: 4.3 Core ablation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 核心损害

blocks.en: The minimal BRNCA of Section 3.3 has two free structural choices, which define its core: the number of hidden channels m m (memory carried by each cell) and the number of neurons d h d_{h} in the hidden layer of the update MLP (capacity of the rule). The perception bank is fixed to identity+Sobel. We evaluate all pairs ( m , d h ) (m,d_{h}) with m ∈ { 10 , 15 , 20 } , d h ∈ { 64,128,256 } , m\in\{10,15,20\},\qquad d_{h}\in\{64,128,256\}, that is, nine configurations, with everything else fixed (synchronous updates, no alive mask, no pool, optimiser and number of steps as in Section 3 ). The experiment addresses two questions: (i) whether every core configuration improves BIoU over the base segmenter; and (ii) how sensitive the gain is to memory ( m m ) and to the capacity of the MLP ( d h d_{h} ).

Table 1: Core ablation on LandCover.ai: mIoU (left) and BmIoU (right), in %, for m m hidden channels in the cell state and d h d_{h} neurons in the hidden layer of the update MLP. Bold: best cell of each metric.
blocks.zh: 表1:LandCover.ai上的核心通缩:mIoU(左)和BmIoU(右),以%表示,为细胞状态中m m 隐藏通道,而d h d_{h}为更新MLP中隐藏层的神经元. 粗体:每个度量的最好的细胞.

blocks.en:
According to Table 1 , every one of the nine configurations improves on the base segmenter in both metrics.
BmIoU rises by 0.93 to 2.36 pp (from 46.63 to between 47.56 and 48.99), while mIoU changes by + 0.17 +0.17 to + 0.62 +0.62 pp (from 83.69 to between 83.86 and 84.31). The gain is thus about four times larger on
the boundary band than on the whole region, as expected from BRNCA, which moves contours and leaves the semantics of the interiors to the base model. The best BmIoU (48.99) is obtained with m = 15 m=15 , d h = 256 d_{h}=256 and the best
mIoU (84.31) with m = 20 m=20 , d h = 256 d_{h}=256 ; the per-class analysis below uses the former. In absolute terms the position error
remains large.
blocks.zh:
根据表1,9个配置中的每一个在两个度量中都改进了基分器.
BmIoU上升了0.93到2.36pp(从46.63到47.56到48.99之间),而mIoU变化了+0.17+0.17到+0.62+0.62pp(从83.69到83.86到84.31之间). 因此,收益大约是四倍
正如BRNCA所预期的那样,边界带比整个区域的边界带要多,它将轮廓移动,将内地的语义留给了基模型. 最佳 BmIoU (48.99) 以 m = 15 m = 15, dh = 256 d_{h}= 256 并获得最佳
mIoU (84.31) 有 m = 20 m = 20, d h = 256 d_{h}=256;下面的每类分析使用前者. 用绝对值表示位置错误
规模仍然很大。

blocks.en: From Table 1 , averaged over m m , BmIoU increases monotonically with d h d_{h} (48.10, 48.45 and 48.86 for d h = 64,128,256 d_{h}=64,128,256 ), while m m has a weaker, non-monotonic effect (48.41, 48.33 and 48.68 for m = 10 , 15 , 20 m=10,15,20 ). This indicates that contour refinement is limited more by local rule capacity than by auxiliary memory. Even the smallest configuration ( m = 10 m=10 , d h = 64 d_{h}=64 ) captures 75% of the maximum gain. Overall, the ablation robustly shows positive gains across all cells, driven mainly by d h d_{h} . This shows that performance depends more on the number of neurons in the hidden layer ( d h d_{h} ) than on the number of hidden channels ( m m ).
blocks.zh: BmIoU从表1(平均为m-m-m)中以d h-d--h}(48.10,48.45和48.86表示d-h=64,128,256 d-h-64,128,256)单调增加,而m-m则具有较弱的非通量效应(48.41,48.33和48.68表示m=10,15,20 m=10,15,20),这表明等由本地规则能力比辅助内存受限制更大. 甚至最小的配置(m = 10 m = 10,d h = 64 d_{h}=64)也捕取了最大增益的75%. 总体来看,这种膨胀在所有细胞中都取得了积极的进展,这主要是由d h d_{h 所推动的。 这表明性能更多地取决于隐藏层(dh d_{h})中的神经元数量,而不是隐藏通道的数量(m m.

blocks.en:
Table 2 decomposes the best configuration by class and relates the change in BIoU to the fractal dimension D D of each class boundary. The gain is far from uniform. Woodland alone gains 8.49 pp of BIoU; background follows with 1.89 pp, then road (0.82), building (0.39) and water (0.21). Without woodland the mean gain falls from 2.36 to 0.83 pp, so the
headline BmIoU is largely coming from the natural irregular class woodland. Global IoU follows the same ordering at a smaller scale (woodland + 2.15 +2.15 ,
background + 0.55 +0.55 ; building, water and road within ± 0.05 \pm 0.05 ) and does not decrease appreciably for any class.
blocks.zh:
表2按类别分解了最佳配置,将BIOU的变化与每个类别边界的分形维度D联系起来. 所得相去相去相去相去相去相去相去. 仅林地就获得了8.49页的BIoU;背景是1.89页,然后是公路(0.82)、建筑(0.39)和水(0.21)。 没有林地,平均收益从2.36降至0.83pp,因此,
头条 BmIoU主要出自天然的不规则类林地. Global IoU在较小的尺度(林地+ 2.15 + 2.15 )上遵循相同的订单,
背景+ 0.55+0.55; 建筑、水和道路在 ± 0.05\pm 0.05 以内,不会明显减少。

blocks.en:
The classes are ordered by BIoU gain almost as they are ordered by D D : water, building and road come first in the
same order in both rankings, and the two classes with the highest D D come last, with woodland ( D = 1.264 D=1.264 ) gaining more than
background ( D = 1.330 D=1.330 ). We notice that the Spearman coefficient is ρ = 0.90 \rho=0.90 , and ρ = 1 \rho=1 if woodland is left out. However, the Spearman coefficient is merely ordinal, in contrast with the magnitude captured by the Pearson coefficient r = 0.38 r=0.38 . So D D is not directly correlated to how large the woodland BIoU gain is, since road and woodland have almost the same dimension (1.260 against 1.264), but gains that differ by a factor of ten (0.82 against 8.49). We conjecture that the pixels that fall inside the BIoU band help explain this discrepancy.
blocks.zh:
这些课程由BIOU订购,
两个排名的顺序相同,DD最高的两个班次最后,林地(D = 1.264 D = 1.264)的得分超过
页:1 我们注意到斯皮尔曼系数为^ 0.90\rho= 0.90,如果林地被排除在外,则等于 1\rho= 1。 然而,斯皮尔曼系数只是平分系数,与皮尔逊系数r=0.38 r=0.38所捕获的等分. 因此,DD与林地BIOU收益有多大没有直接关联,因为路地和林地的维度几乎相同(1.264相比为1.260相比),但收益相差了十倍(0.82相比为8.49相比为一等分. 我们推测BIOU乐队内部的像素能帮助解释这种差异.

blocks.en:
Road is thin and tubular, meaning a large share of its area lies within the band, keeping the band metric close to the global one; furthermore, its remaining contour is regular, which the base segmenter already localises well. By contrast, woodland forms massive, grouped patches, so only a small share of its pixels resides in the band, concentrating the base model’s errors there.
Background is a special case, since an
improvement of the contours of building, road or woodland is also an improvement of the contour of the background.
blocks.zh:
道路是薄而有管状的,意味着它的大部分区域位于波段内,使波段的度量值接近全球;此外,其所剩的轮廓是常态的,而基部分解器已经非常适合它。 相比之下,林地形成庞大的,分组的补丁,因此其像素中只有一小部分停留在波段中,把基模的错误集中在那里.
背景情况很特殊,因为
改善建筑、道路或林地的轮廓也是背景轮廓的改进。

blocks.en:
The interior is not free. IIoU does not increase for any class and drops most where the boundary gain is largest: woodland − 0.79 -0.79 , background − 0.32 -0.32 , road − 0.04 -0.04 , building − 0.02 -0.02 , water 0.00 0.00 . The ranking by interior loss is exactly the ranking
by BIoU gain (Spearman ρ = − 1 \rho=-1 between Δ \Delta BIoU and Δ \Delta IIoU, Pearson r = − 0.98 r=-0.98 ): the classes that benefit most from
repositioning the contour are those whose interiors lose most. The loss is small against the gain (on average − 0.23 -0.23 pp against + 2.36 +2.36 pp) and BIoU and IIoU are measured on different pixel populations, so they cannot simply be subtracted; the
commensurable evidence is that the global mIoU rises ( + 0.54 +0.54 pp), so the net effect over all pixels is positive. One plausible reading is that a rule shared by all cells, when it moves a contour, also perturbs
interior cells, producing isolated misclassified pixels or small spurious regions within previously correct areas.
blocks.zh:
内地不放逸. 在边界收益最大的地区,IIoU不会增加和减少:林地-0.79-0.79;背景-0.32-0.32;公路-0.04-0.04;建筑-0.02-0.02;取水-0.00.00。 按内损排列的排名正是排名
===============================================================
重新布置轮廓是内部损失最大的人. 损失小于增益(平均为− 0.23-0.23 pp对+ 2.36 + 2.36 pp),BIOU和IIOU按不同的像素群计量,因此不能简单地被减去;
相适应的证据是全球mIoU的上升(+0.54+0.54pp),因此在所有像素上的净效应是正的. 一种合理的解读是,所有细胞共同使用的规则, 当它移动轮廓时, 也扰动

The automaton is trained and evaluated for a fixed number of steps ( T = 64 T=64 at inference). Figure 5 runs the best configuration for twice that number of steps and plots the BmIoU gain at
every step. The gain grows monotonically up to a plateau between roughly t = 60 t=60 and t = 72 t=72 , where it reaches the 2.36 pp
of Table 1 , and then declines: about 1.96 pp at t = 96 t=96 and about 0.60 pp at t = 128 t=128 , a quarter of the peak, still
positive but heading toward deterioration. Three things follow. First, the maximum training step of T = 64 T=64 , fixed beforehand, falls within the plateau that is best a posteriori. Second, the dynamics is not
a convergence to a fixed point that preserves the refined contour; the automaton behaves as a transient that is good at the time
it was trained for and that keeps changing, in the wrong direction, afterwards.
Third, the decay is gradual compared to the rise in Figure 5 , meaning BRNCA does not diverge abruptly; nevertheless, running inference past the maximum training step ( T = 64 T=64 ) departs from the training objective and results in a performance loss.

blocks.en:
This is the price of the minimal design. Without the sample pool the rule is never trained on states beyond the maximum training step, so those it meets at t > 64 t>64 are outside the training distribution and its behaviour is unconstrained. The same effect
motivated the pool in Growing NCA, where it was introduced to make the pattern persist [ 10 ] .

这是最小设计的价格。 没有样本池,规则就从未在最大培训步骤之外对各州进行训练,因此,在t > 64 t > 64相会的州不在培训分配范围,其行为不受限制。 同样的效果
推动在成长型国家竞争主管机构中建立人才库,并引入该人才库,使模式得以延续。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
A small, minimal BRNCA applied on top of a frozen segmenter raises BmIoU on LandCover.ai by 0.9 to 2.4 pp while mIoU
changes by 0.2 to 0.6 pp, in all nine configurations of the ablation. The effect is therefore robust to the choice of m m and d h d_{h} . However, the structural choice that clearly matters is the capacity of
the rule. The gain is selective: it is concentrated on woodland and is small (below 1 pp) for building, water and road, and the
ranking of the classes by gain broadly follows the ranking by the fractal dimension of their boundaries. Because the interior metric falls in the classes where the boundary metric rises, BRNCA behaves as a re-allocation of accuracy toward the boundary band rather than a free
improvement, although the net effect over all pixels is positive. The scale of the effect is modest: BmIoU stays below 50%, and BRNCA removes only a small part of the position error of the base segmenter.
blocks.zh:
在冷冻接线器上应用的少量BRNCA将LandCover.ai上的BmIoU提升为0.9至2.4pp,而mIoU则提升为0.9至2.4pp.
由0.2到0.6页的修改,在全部9个构型中都使用. 因此,在 m和 d h d_{h 的选择上效果强劲. 然而,显然重要的结构选择是:
规则。 收益是选择性的:它集中于林地,小(低于一页)用于建筑、水和道路,以及
类别按收益排序大致遵循其边界分形的排序。 由于内部测量值在边界测量值上升的类别中下降,BRNCA表现为精确度向边界波段的再分配,而不是免费
改进,虽然对所有像素的净效果是正的. 效果的尺度是适度的: BmIoU 保持在50%以下,而 BRNCA 则只去除一小部分碱分器的位置错误.

blocks.en: The qualitative view and the behaviour past T = 64 T=64 shed light on two key aspects of the design choices in Section 3.3 . First, since every cell updates without an alive mask or pixelwise dropout, the rule is free to shift wrong contours, which is precisely what boundary correction requires; the same choice generates an interior perturbation, causing IIoU degradation by modifying non-boundary regions. Second, dropping the sample pool makes training computationally efficient, and the automaton still achieves its peak performance at the maximum training step ( T = 64 T=64 ), but it leaves the dynamics beyond that step uncontrolled ( Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 定性观点和过去的行为 T=64 T=64 揭示了第3.3节中设计选择的两个关键方面. 首先,由于每一个没有活口面具或像素失传的细胞更新,规则可以自由转出错误的轮廓,这正是边界修正所需要的;同样的选择会产生内部扰动,通过修改非边界区域而导致IIoU退化. 第二,抛出样本池使训练在计算上效率高,自发体在最大训练步(T=64 T=64)时仍然能达到峰值性能,但使该步外的动态不受控制(第4.6节).

blocks.en:
This study relies on a single frozen base segmenter (DPT–DINOv2) evaluated on one benchmark (LandCover.ai), using three values per axis ( m m and d h d_{h} ) in the core ablation. The conditioning encoder and the number of automaton steps are held fixed.
The alive mask, the sample pool and the asynchronous update are removed by design and not ablated, so their effect on boundary
position is argued but not measured here, apart from the indirect evidence of Section 4.6 . The per-class conclusions rest on
five classes and a single configuration, and the explanations offered for them (the share of pixels inside the band, small-scale
changes along fractal contours, perturbation of interior cells) are conjectures that this study did not test. BIoU is computed for
a single band width. Finally, the mean gains are of the order of one to two BIoU points, and differences of a few tenths of a point
between cells are not interpreted. Comparisons with other boundary refiners and the computational cost of the refinement are not
reported in this version.

blocks.en:
Three directions follow. First, restoring the sample pool and studying the convergence and the attractors of the learned dynamics,
so as to obtain a stopping criterion more robust than the present number of steps ( T = 64 T=64 ) and to let BRNCA refine the boundaries beyond this value. Second, a comparison with the boundary refiners reviewed in Section 2 (for instance dense CRF, SegFix and
SegRefiner) on at least two base segmenters, a convolutional U-Net with an EfficientNet-B7 encoder and DPT–DINOv2, reporting Δ \Delta IoU, Δ \Delta BIoU and computational cost. Third, evaluation on further land-cover data, including a new dataset of the
APA Petrópolis protected area built in partnership with ICMBio [ 5 ] , which has 8 classes without a background , and high annotation precision in boundary position.
blocks.zh:
三个方向跟着。 首先,恢复样本库,研究所学动态的趋同和吸引者,
以便获得比目前步骤数(T = 64 T = 64)更坚固的停止标准,并让BRNCA完善超出这个值的边界. 第二,与第2节所审查的边界精炼厂进行比较(例如密集的通用报告格式、SegFix和

亚太 Petrópolis保护区与IMBio[5]合作建造,该保护区有8个等级,没有背景,边界位置的注释精度也很高.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced BRNCA, which casts multiclass boundary refinement as the iteration of a small learned local rule on top of a frozen segmenter and reduces the NCA to its core: class probabilities kept on the simplex by an Aitchison update, free hidden channels, a fixed
perception bank and synchronous updates, with no sample pool or alive mask. On LandCover.ai all nine configurations of the m × d h m\times d_{h} ablation improve BmIoU over a DPT–DINOv2 base, by 0.9 to 2.4 pp (46.63 to 48.99 for the best, m = 15 m=15 , d h = 256 d_{h}=256 ),
with mIoU changing by + 0.2 +0.2 to + 0.6 +0.6 pp. The capacity of the update rule matters more than the number of hidden channels, and
the smallest configuration already keeps three quarters of the best BIoU gain. The gain is concentrated on woodland ( + 8.5 +8.5 pp
BIoU, 72% of the total over classes); the classes are ordered by gain almost as they are ordered by the fractal dimension of
their boundaries, and the gain is accompanied by a small loss of interior IoU that is larger where the boundary gain is larger.
The gain peaks at the number of steps used in training ( T = 64 T=64 in this case) and decays when the automaton runs longer.
